# FusionCandlestick

> `fscandle` is a non-commercial, source-available HTML5 Canvas K-line
> (candlestick) chart engine with a custom renderer. It builds its own charting
> surface rather than wrapping an existing library; KLineCharts and Lightweight
> Charts are used only as reference baselines, not dependencies.

This site (fusioncandlestick.dev) is the marketing page and interactive
playground. The engine is a separate repository and npm package, `fscandle`.

Status: v0.1.0. The public API is 0.x and may change between minor versions.

## What it is

- A framework-neutral chart engine: `createChart(container, options)` from
  `fscandle`.
- A React entry: `FusionCandlestickChartComponent` from `fscandle/react`
  (ships the `"use client"` directive; importable from a Next.js App Router
  server component). `react` and `react-dom` >= 18 are optional peer dependencies.
- A datafeed entry: `bindMarketDataFeed` and static / replay / polling /
  WebSocket feed helpers from `fscandle/datafeed`.

## This site

- `/` — product homepage: capability tour, live demos, FAQ, SEO/GEO metadata.
- `/playground` — a multi-panel workspace shell: drawing tools and layers,
  compare series, watchlist, layouts, screenshot, fullscreen, symbol switching.
- Every route is prerendered to static HTML; there is no server runtime.

## Engine capabilities

- Series renderers (8): candlestick, hollow candle, Heikin-Ashi, OHLC bar,
  area, line, step line, baseline; plus a volume mode.
- Built-in indicators (16): MA, EMA, BOLL, MACD, RSI, KDJ, WR, VOLMA, ATR,
  ADX, ROC, CCI, OBV, VWAP, STOCHRSI, PSAR.
- Multiple panes, multi-column price axes, synced charts, overlay drawing
  tools with magnet snapping, and local state persistence.
- Public facade APIs: `timeScale()`, `priceScale()`, `series()`, `pane()`.
- `ChartPrimitive` extension API: pane/axis views, hit testing, pointer handlers.
- Declarative custom series via `defineSeriesType`; custom overlays via figure
  descriptors with draw/select/click/drag/remove lifecycle callbacks.
- Explicit `Period` / `TradingSession` model with timezone-aware axis
  labelling and session-aware gap compression (e.g. `cn-futures-night`).
- Nine packaged locale dictionaries (en-US, zh-CN, zh-TW, ja-JP, ko-KR,
  de-DE, es-ES, fr-FR, ru-RU) with fallback resolution.
- Typed event subscriptions: click, double click, context menu, crosshair
  move, visible range, size, overlay change, data change.
- Multi-touch pinch-to-zoom and two-finger pan.

## Performance notes (no guaranteed numbers)

The project publishes no benchmarked production performance guarantee for v0.1.
Every bar is drawn in one Canvas pass with no per-bar DOM nodes; drawing is
device-pixel aware. A browser frame benchmark fails the build on median/p95
frame-interval and heap-growth regressions; the engine survives large datasets
in its own stability probe. Treat any specific FPS or latency figure as
unverified unless it comes from that harness.
